rationale: Reconcile pre-existing Benefits runtime and HC-1.0 Health-domain gap-registry code into the governed capability catalog, and assign three pre-existing executable contracts to their already-registered semantic owners. No new governed Python implementation or feature behavior is added; the slice records existing authority boundaries and closes remaining insurance_intelligence census drift.
supersession_impact: None. No capability is removed, replaced or superseded; the Health-domain gap registry is explicitly recorded as DISCONNECTED rather than promoted into active runtime authority.
authority_impact: Makes existing Benefits factual-comparison, intrinsic-assessment, trade-off, mechanic-semantic, fact-publication and pre-ranking admission boundaries explicit while preserving the prohibition on aggregate ranking, winner selection, suitability and recommendation. Context, reasoning and response authority are unchanged; only their executable contract ownership is reconciled.
